whatItIs: dimod is an open-source project in the annealing and ising category. It is maintained by dwavesystems and primarily looks like a Python codebase. A shared API for QUBO/Ising samplers.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches annealing and ising workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: dimod is a shared API for samplers. It provides: Classes for quadratic models---such as the binary quadratic model (BQM) class that contains Ising and QUBO models used by samplers such as the D-Wave quantum computer---and higher-order (non-quadratic) models. Reference examples of samplers and composed samplers. Abstract base classes...
whoItsFor: Developers interested in Ising-model formulations, annealing workflows, and D-Wave-style solver ecosystems.
